title: About Friends of Brookside Park
lead: A neighborhood-led group supporting the park, waterway, and trail corridor.
paragraphs: Friends of Brookside Park is a volunteer-driven community organization in Indianapolis focused on access, stewardship, and celebration of public space.
We partner with neighborhood groups, city agencies, and local nonprofits to improve trails, host educational events, and make the park more welcoming for everyone.
Our members include walkers, riders, anglers, teachers, artists, families, and nearby businesses who care deeply about the long-term health of Brookside Park and Pogue's Run.
